name: Municipal Credit Union (MCU)
notes: Researched from public nymcu.org pages (no sign-in). Loan payments page promotes "MCU Loan Payments" on Swivelpay (SWBC): one-time payments with a non-MCU debit card or ACH from another institution, and recurring ACH from another institution; members register on Swivelpay (separate sign-up; modelled as the family guest-pay flow). One-time Swivelpay payments carry a $4.95 convenience fee (recurring ACH does not: cannot be expressed per schedule, so guest fees are $4.95 and AutoPay is free); payments after 9:00 PM EST process the next business day; not all loan types/statuses are eligible. Fee-free alternatives: MCU Online Banking / Mobile app, branch, mailed check. Digital Banking: Log In / Register at digital.nymcu.org. Hardship: Consumer Hardship Assistance Application (e-sign or PDF), MCU replies within 2-3 business days, keep paying during review (payment_arrangement unsupported online). Contact 1-844-MCU-NYNY (1-844-628-6969). Sign-in identifier/MFA not documented (family defaults).

help.title: Loan payments
paragraphs: MCU Loan Payments, provided by SWBC through Swivelpay, lets you make a one-time loan payment with a non-MCU debit card or an ACH transfer from another institution, or set up recurring ACH payments from another institution. Register once and save the link for future payments.

One-time payments made there carry a $4.95 convenience fee; recurring ACH payments do not. Payments submitted after 9:00 PM EST are processed the next business day, and not every loan type or status can be paid this way.
To avoid the fee, pay in MCU Online Banking or the Mobile Banking app, at a branch, or by mailing a check. Questions: 1-844-MCU-NYNY (1-844-628-6969).

help.title: Member hardship assistance
paragraphs: Having trouble making loan payments? Fill out the Consumer Hardship Assistance Application (homeowners use the Residential Hardship Assistance Application) and submit any required documents.

MCU will reach out within 2 to 3 business days of receiving your application to confirm it and ask for anything else it needs. Keep making your regular monthly payments while it is reviewed; approval is not guaranteed.
